_doc: Stream E (play-test 2, Q27). THE STARTING CHAIN every new character gets, whatever the class: 'The South Road'. Merged into zone 'test' (The Torbor Fields) by test.json `include`. Elder Maud in Torborhold -> the south road -> the Pail and Plough (a crossroads inn, set piece sp_pail_and_plough) -> TWO branches the innkeeper hands out together, done in either order: (A) on to Orrinsford, the next town (Prior Wendel, zone saint_orrins_rise) and his small favour at Saint Hulda's Yard; (B) Greyfletch Camp's huntmaster, the beast's signs, then the mini boss Old Gristle at Gristle's Hollow (data/encounters/mb_old_gristle.json, level 2 since play-test 3 R2; Signs of the Beast and Old Gristle are level-2 quests). Both done -> 'Home with News' back to Maud, which leads into the province story (toll_at_fitockpi). Levels 1 -> 5 over ~1.7 km of road, with fights on the way so a new character levels into the boss. NEW FIELDS for stream A (docs/requests.md, E -> A play-test 2): `auto: true` = granted to every new character (and to any character that has neither done nor holds it) — it starts in the quest log; `requires: [ids]` = offered only when EVERY listed quest is done (on top of the `next` rule). `rewardText` = one player-facing line summing up the reward. W5 (owner feedback 8): `start_wheels_for_hire` — the carter outside Orrinsford's gate (`carter_orrinsford`, an NPC of saint_orrins_rise.json made by tools/content-towns.mjs) offers it once the letter is delivered: a free token and one ride back to Torborhold, where the Prior's favour is anyway. It is a side step, not required by Home with News. New: step kind `ride` {from?, to} (stop ids of data/provinces/carts.json; done when a cart ride arrives at `to`), quest `tip` (one paragraph the client may show as a how-to when the quest is taken).

innkeeper_marra.name: Marra Thatcher
innkeeper_marra.greeting: Sit down before you fall down. Stew's a copper. Trouble's free, and I've plenty of it.

quests.name: Two Good Legs
quests.offer: You've a weapon and two good legs, which makes you the most useful person in Torborhold this week. Before I send you anywhere far, prove the legs work: the moor hounds are at the sheep folds again. Then go out to the Drill Field by the gate and find whoever teaches your sort of trouble.

steps.text: Kill 3 moor hounds near the sheep folds
steps.where: the sheep folds and open grass just outside Torborhold
Torbor Drill Field, just outside Torborhold's gate

quests.done: Good. You came back, and with all your fingers. That's more than the last three. Now, a real errand.
quests.rewardText: A purse of coin, and the Elder's next errand: the south road.

quests.name: Letters for the South Road
quests.offer: Prior Wendel in Orrinsford has asked Torborhold for help, and Marra at the Pail and Plough says the south road's gone bad. Take this letter south. Clear what's sniffing along the road, and stop at the Pail and Plough on the way. Marra will feed you and tell you the rest, at length.

steps.text: Kill 5 moor hounds along the south road
steps.where: the south road out of Torborhold, toward the Pail and Plough

steps.text: Talk to Marra at the Pail and Plough
steps.where: the Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn halfway to Orrinsford

quests.done: A letter for the Prior and a sword that's been used? Sit. Eat. Then I've two jobs and you can do them in whatever order your legs like.
quests.rewardText: Coin, a bowl of stew, and two new jobs from Marra (do them in either order).

quests.name: The Road to Orrinsford
quests.offer: The Elder's letter won't walk itself to Orrinsford. Read the notice post on your way out — the toll men have been stopping carts south of here, and two of my regulars came back without their boots. Deal with them, then take the letter to Prior Wendel.

steps.text: Read the notice post at the Pail and Plough
steps.where: the notice post by the Pail and Plough's door

steps.text: Kill 4 road brigands holding up the carts
steps.where: the road south of the Pail and Plough, toward Orrinsford

steps.text: Give the Elder's letter to Prior Wendel in Orrinsford
steps.where: Orrinsford, the next town south (Saint Orrin's Rise)

quests.done: Maud's hand, and Maud's temper. Yes, we will send what help we can. But first, a small favour of my own, if your boots are still on.
quests.rewardText: Coin, and you have reached Orrinsford — the Prior has a favour to ask. The carter outside the gate will run you back north for a few coins.

quests.name: Wheels for Hire
quests.offer: You walked here from Torborhold? On purpose? Sit down. The Longroad Carters keep a cart outside the gate of every town in the Downs: tell the carter where, pay the fare, and the ox does the walking. Dearer the further you go, and it will take you to towns you have never set eyes on. Here, a token: the first ride is on the Prior. Try it back to Torborhold.

steps.text: Ride an ox cart from Orrinsford to Torborhold
steps.where: Talk to the carter by the ox cart outside Orrinsford's gate, and pick Torborhold

quests.tip: Ox carts: a carter stands by a parked cart outside every town's main gate. Talk to one (E), pick a town and pay the fare to ride there. You do not need to have been there before. Now and then a cart is on the road too: flag it down the same way.
quests.done: There. Your boots thank you. Any carter, any gate, any town: we are slow, but we are everywhere.
quests.rewardText: A little coin and experience, and you know how to cross the Downs sitting down.

quests.name: The Prior's Favour
quests.offer: Our pilgrims bury their dead at Saint Hulda's Yard, on the way back to Torborhold. Something has been digging there. Barrow hounds — grave dogs. Drive them off, and ring the sexton's bell so the dead know they are left in peace. Then tell Maud we will stand with her.

steps.text: Kill 4 barrow hounds at Saint Hulda's Yard
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the old graveyard between Torborhold and the south road

steps.text: Ring the sexton's bell at Saint Hulda's Yard
steps.where: the bell by the lychgate of Saint Hulda's Yard

quests.done: The bell carries all the way here, you know. Thank you. Go home with my answer: Orrinsford stands with Torborhold.
quests.rewardText: Coin, a piece of gear, and the Prior's answer to carry home.

quests.name: Signs of the Beast
quests.offer: Something big has been taking drovers' dogs off the road at night. Not a wolf — a wolf doesn't leave tracks like dinner plates. Oswy Greyfletch keeps a hunters' camp in the trees west of here. Ask him what it is, and help him find out where it sleeps.

steps.text: Ask Oswy Greyfletch about the beast
steps.where: Greyfletch Camp, the hunters' camp at the edge of the woods

steps.text: Collect 4 matted grey tufts from moor hounds
steps.where: moor hound packs around Greyfletch Camp and the south road

steps.text: Mark the tufts on Greyfletch's tally board
steps.where: the tally board at Greyfletch Camp

quests.done: Grey, coarse, and every tuft from a different dog. They're all his pack. Old Gristle. I thought he was dead. I hoped he was dead.
quests.rewardText: Coin, and the hunters know the beast's name and where it sleeps.

quests.name: Old Gristle
quests.group: a solo at level 2, or 2-3 players
quests.offer: Nine winters he's led the packs into the folds, and he's grown the size of a pony on Torborhold's sheep. He dens in a hollow full of bones, out past the camp. When he howls, the pack comes — kill the hounds he calls, and stay out of the line when he crouches. He pounces long.

steps.where: Gristle's Hollow, a bone-strewn den a few hundred metres past Greyfletch Camp

quests.done: You did it. You actually did it. Take this — I made it for the day somebody did. Go and tell Marra she can let the dogs out again.
quests.rewardText: A rare piece of gear and a fat purse — and Torborhold's folds are safe.

quests.name: Home with News
quests.offer: Orrinsford stands with us and Old Gristle is dead? You've done in a week what my reeve couldn't do in a year. Tell Corwin yourself — I want to see his face — and then come back. There's worse than hounds at Fitockpi Ford.

steps.text: Tell Reeve Corwin the south road is safe

quests.done: Corwin's face, I'm told, was a picture. Here. You've earned something better than stew. Now — about that ford.
quests.rewardText: A rare weapon, the Elder's thanks, and the province story begins: Hobb's toll gang at Fitockpi Ford.
